Theme

Latin word

sēdūcō

sēdūcō, sēdūcere, sēdūxī, sēductum

verb, third conjugation, transitive

take (someone) aside

In this lexicon

  • aside

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Aul. 133: eō nunc ego sēcrētō tēd hūc forās sēdūxī; Cic. Att. 5.21.12 (Lewis & Short): mē rūrsus sēdūcit

Examples

  • Sēcēde hūc. nam sunt quae ex tē sōlō scītārī volō.

    Step aside over here: there are things I want to ask you alone.Plaut. Capt. 263

    In the entry for aside

  • eō nunc ego sēcrētō tēd hūc forās sēdūxī, ut tuam rem ego tēcum hīc loquerer familiārem.

    That’s why I’ve taken you aside out here privately, to talk with you about your family affairs.Plaut. Aul. 133–134

    In the entry for aside
